_comment: Declared attributes no platform converter reads. Hand-maintained: close a gap by implementing it (then delete the entry) or by narrowing platform/mode in attribute_definitions.json. reason is one of: dynamic-key, legacy, platform-na, runtime-only, unimplemented.

stickyHeader exists only on LazyColumn/LazyRow, not LazyVerticalGrid, and this component's section headers are emitted in the grid path via item(span = GridItemSpan). The single-column path delegates to the CollectionStack composable, so this is a KotlinJsonUI library feature plus codegen plumbing.
